{{Top|leg}}
A '''Lovolol cleaning droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] around [[43 ABY]] for cleaning. One of these droids was used by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] to infiltrate the Temple and gather information from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
